villain.name: Max Vathen
villain.known: A billionaire has bought an island nation and is building something on it.
villain.forces: Private security, a fleet, more money than several states.

parts.label: Serves Another
parts.text: They answer to a greater master who stays off the page but darkens everything.

parts.label: Syndicate
parts.text: Several organizations with one shared purpose; lieutenants may each head one of them.

parts.label: Upscale
parts.text: Roll again and scale the result up in size and scope, applying both sets of modifiers. Upscale or Double rolled again is re-rolled.

parts.label: Secret Society
parts.text: It operates unseen, behind everything, which takes real coordination to sustain.

parts.label: True Believer
parts.text: They believe in the villain's mission, sincerely, and are here to serve it.

parts.label: Teamwork
parts.text: Two or more of them work together. Roll another archetype and either give it to all of them or roll one each. Teamwork rolled again reads as As Expected.

parts.label: Fight Club
parts.text: Whatever else they are for, what they want is to fight the player character.

parts.label: Specialist
parts.text: Extremely good at one thing, which is the thing they are here for.

parts.label: Right Hand
parts.text: Second only to the villain, and able to stand in for them.

parts.label: Soldier
parts.text: A soldier, probably one of many, ready to fight for the villain.
